Vertical 9:16 cinematic PASTEL WATERCOLOR ANIME illustration, unmistakably hand-drawn 2D animation background, fine ink contours, visible watercolor paper grain, layered translucent brush washes, softly simplified painted geometry and expressive Tamil anime characters. Not a photograph, not a photoreal render. Warm terracotta brick, faded teal wood, forest-green chalkboard, dusty rose and pale apricot sunlight. Premium detail comes from composition, painted depth and dramatic diagonal sunbeams. Modern Tamil college romance. No wedding-hotel decor, marble lobby, brass inlay, floral aisle, ribbon, phone, watermark or unrelated readable text.

Straight-on camera aligned with the SAME college entrance, now at the threshold looking down its central aisle. A South Indian COLLEGE MAIN ACADEMIC BLOCK: weathered terracotta red-brick facade, cream lintels, shaded veranda, tall faded-teal timber double doors at the centre, each leaf with three rectangular solid panels and one simple dark iron handle. Three worn grey-granite entrance steps. Left of doors: a wooden campus noticeboard holding small blank pastel sheets. Right of doors: an old wooden student bench with two closed books. Timber classroom windows and leafy campus trees frame the building. Inside these doors is the ground-floor college lecture hall, not an event venue: honey-brown wooden student desks on both sides of ONE wide central aisle, tall barred classroom windows on LEFT, red-oxide floor, a large dark-green chalkboard mounted on the pale cream far wall. A simple wooden lectern stands off to the right of the chalkboard. No second set of doors. Both teal doors have opened inward on their side hinges; their painted panel edges remain at the far left and right of frame. The SAME red-oxide floor continues from the entrance; desks stay visibly to the sides, with the chalkboard centred ahead. Frame the board close enough that the words occupy about half the picture width. On the board, elegant large hand-lettered IVORY CHALK reads EXACTLY "Save The Date", two lines "Save The" then "Date"; subtle chalk texture, clean counters, warm light across letters, not gold metal lettering. Only these three words in the entire image. The classroom architecture, side desks, windows, books and lectern make the college unmistakable. Fine chalk dust and two small blank paper slips hover gently by the side desks. No people, flowers, wedding stage or circular light feature.
